titles.title: Public Access to HHS Health Data Act of 2026
Public Access to HHS Health Data Act of 2026
To require the Secretary of Health and Human Services to create a repository of certain publicly available data sets.

action.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committees on Ways and Means, Education and Workforce, and Natural Resources, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
